feedback: Judged from earlier races only; no outcome is stated for this candidate. Iteration 2 (kp 8.0, kd 0.2) is the best raced design at 49.78, with progress 0.18 on the oval, 0.10 on the s-bend and 0.085 on the slalom. Iteration 3 (kp 6.0, kd 0.2) fell to 36.05, with progress 0.12 / 0.04 / 0.10. Progress tracks kp across the two raced points, so kp 7.0 should sit between them, though it may not beat the kp 8 score. Steering_oscillation rose from about 0.07 at kp 5-6 to 0.13-0.15 at kp 8, so kp 7 is a reasonable compromise. Every raced run ended off_track with one line-loss event and max_error near 0.06 to 0.066, so the standing offset and the dead band remain the unresolved problems. The change is a single gain step with geometry, base_speed, ki and line_loss unchanged, and the contract is respected. Approve: this is a clean, low-risk test with plenty of iterations left, and the telemetry will show whether progress holds at the kp 8 level while oscillation falls. Next race: (a) If oval progress is at or above about 0.15 and steering_oscillation is at or below about 0.13, keep kp 7.0 and move to sensor geometry in one revision. (b) If progress is clearly below the kp 8 level, return to kp 8.0 with kd 0.2, since gain is the main source of progress. (c) If max_error is still near 0.06 with low oscillation, the centre-sensor dead band is the likely cause, so change sensor_size to 0.016. (d) If the robot tracks the line without an off-track event but completion_time exceeds 3 s, raise base_speed to 1.6 in a later single-group revision.
requested_changes: If oval progress is at or above about 0.15 and steering_oscillation is at or below about 0.13, keep kp 7.0 and set sensor_size = 0.016 next, because the 12 mm sensors at 0.02 m spacing leave a dead band around centre against the 25 mm tape (iteration 2 max_error 0.066 on the oval).
If progress drops clearly below the kp 8 level, set kp = 8.0 with kd = 0.2, since iteration 2 gave oval progress 0.18 versus 0.12 at kp 6 (iteration 3).
If the robot tracks the line without off-track but completion_time exceeds 3 s, set base_speed = 1.6, because the 3.0 s limit needs an average speed of about 1.5 m/s.
